name: sprint45_volspike_drift_spy_v6_n_gt0_confirmed
hypothesis: After a 3x volume spike on SPY 1m RTH bars, the following 30m drift is non-zero (close-auction/news-volume flow; distinct from closed crypto volspike universes). Sprints 38/39/41/43/44 returned n=0 from loader defects, so the mechanism is still unscored.
power_argument: Expected validation trades ~63 RTH days x cap 10 = up to 630, above the 300 floor. SPY 30m stdev ~20bp gives SE ~1.15bp at n=300 and min detectable edge ~2.3bp at t=2. PASS needs net-of-T2 t>=2, i.e. gross >~28bp, far above the detectable floor, so the criterion can fail under the null. C0 must give net ~-26bp on this loader (a C0 pass halts the sprint); C1 +25bp planted edge must PASS.
prerequisite: backtest_auditor shows a dry-run with n>0 on BOTH research and validation windows, and C0/C1 pass on the current loader, before scoring. If n=0 again, do not score; escalate the loader defect instead.
